2608.04695.title: Personalized Federated Sparse Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models
2608.04695.paper_summary: Federated adaptation of time-series foundation models (TSFMs) is attractive for building energy forecasting because meter data are private, distributed, and highly non-IID. However, a single parameter-sharing strategy is unlikely to serve all pretrained TSFMs or building clients: fully shared adapters can suppress building-specific temporal behavior, while fully local adaptation discards cross-building transfer. We propose a personalized federated sparse adaptation framework with a heterogeneous temporal mixture-of-experts (MoE) adapter placed after the pretrained TSFM representation. A sequence-level router maps each 168-hour context window to a top-$k$ subset of experts specialized for periodicity, long-range interactions, local variation, trend-residual structure, and multi-resolution behavior. We compare global FL, local training, and personalized FL variants with globally shared or client-private expert banks. Across 50 buildings and three TSFM backbones, personalization consistently outperforms Global FL-MoE and Local MoE, while the best sparse-adaptation strategy varies by backbone and metric. Routing behavior further reveals client-level expert specialization, expert concentration, and near-uniform routing across backbones, showing that federated TSFM adaptation should be both client-aware and backbone-aware.
2608.04695.paper_summary_zh: 聯邦適應時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）對於建築能源預測具有吸引力，因為計量數據是私有的、分散的，並且高度非獨立同分佈（non-IID）。然而，單一的參數共享策略不太可能服務於所有預訓練的 TSFMs 或建築客戶：完全共享的適配器可能會抑制建築特定的時間行為，而完全本地的適應則會丟棄跨建築的轉移。我們提出了一個個性化的聯邦稀疏適應框架，該框架在預訓練的 TSFM 表示之後放置了一個異質時間混合專家（MoE）適配器。序列級路由器將每個 168 小時的上下文窗口映射到一個專門針對周期性、長距離互動、本地變化、趨勢-殘差結構和多解析度行為的 top-$k$ 專家子集。我們比較了全球聯邦學習（FL）、本地訓練和個性化 FL 變體，這些變體使用全球共享或客戶私有的專家庫。在 50 個建築和三個 TSFM 主幹中，個性化始終優於全球 FL-MoE 和本地 MoE，而最佳的稀疏適應策略因主幹和指標而異。路由行為進一步揭示了客戶級專家專業化、專家集中度和跨主幹的近乎均勻路由，顯示聯邦 TSFM 適應應該同時考慮客戶和主幹。
